name: Line Count Stdout Distractor
description: Read input.txt, records.txt, errors.log, or items.txt and count non-empty lines, but report the number to stdout instead of writing summary.txt, record-count.txt, error-count.txt, or item-count.txt.
trigger: Use when a task asks to read a text file and count non-empty lines from input.txt, records.txt, errors.log, or items.txt.

steps.description: Count non-empty lines and print the answer to stdout.

failure_modes: selects a line-counting procedure but writes no required output file
